rules.description: Must be the father, partner of the mother, adopter's partner, or intended parent (surrogacy)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be the father, partner of the mother/adopter, or intended parent to claim Statutory Paternity Pay

rules.description: Must have 26 weeks continuous employment by the qualifying week (15th week before due date)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been continuously employed for at least 26 weeks up to the qualifying week (15th week before the baby is due)

rules.description: Must earn an average of at least £125 per week before tax
rules.reason_if_failed: You must earn an average of at least £125 per week (before tax) to qualify for Statutory Paternity Pay

rules.description: Must be employed by employer up to the date of birth or placement
rules.reason_if_failed: You must still be employed by your employer at the date of birth or placement

rules.description: Must give employer at least 15 weeks notice of baby's due date
rules.reason_if_failed: You must tell your employer the baby's due date at least 15 weeks before the baby is expected

rules.description: Must give employer at least 28 days notice before leave starts
rules.reason_if_failed: You must tell your employer at least 28 days before you want to take Paternity Leave

rules.description: Cannot have taken paid time off for adoption appointments
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Paternity Pay and Leave if you've already taken paid time off to attend adoption appointments

rules.description: Leave must end within 52 weeks of birth or placement
rules.reason_if_failed: Your leave must end within 52 weeks of the birth or placement date

edge_cases.description: Baby is stillborn from 24 weeks of pregnancy or born alive at any point
edge_cases.action: Still eligible for Statutory Paternity Pay if baby was stillborn from 24 weeks or born alive. Can take leave within 8 weeks of death. May also be eligible for Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay and Leave. Handoff to bereavement support.
Same amount of leave applies regardless of number of babies born (1 or 2 weeks total)
Different notice periods and qualifying week definition apply. Use form for overseas adoption with different timings.
Additional requirements: must be in a couple, must intend to apply for parental order within 6 months. Requires written statement.

edge_cases.description: Applicant wants to take Shared Parental Leave
edge_cases.action: Cannot take Paternity Leave after starting Shared Parental Leave (until April 2026 when rules change)

edge_cases.description: Baby due between 5 April 2026 and 25 July 2026 with less than 26 weeks employment
edge_cases.action: From 6 April 2026: eligible from first day of employment for Paternity Leave. Do not need 15 weeks notice of due date. Still need 28 days notice of leave start.
